name: Tom Demille
office: City of West Hollywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: His candidate statement lists his occupation as a thespian. During President Barack Obama's 2012 re-election campaign, he was a phone bank co-captain. He uses a wheelchair.

sentences.text: His candidate statement lists his occupation as a thespian.
During President Barack Obama's 2012 re-election campaign, he was a phone bank co-captain.

items.text: He says his priority is keeping streets safe from crime and developers. He wants the city to remove Flock Safety cameras. He says the Fountain Avenue Streetscape project needs reevaluation. He wants more civic participation, saying residents have stopped attending city council meetings. During a public comment, he urged the city council to address safety, cleanliness and public health concerns related to unhoused people.
